description: Returns every design token of one extracted brand style: colours, font families and sizes, spacing, radii, CSS variables and the generated DESIGN.md (up to 4000 characters). Use it to theme your own code or set up a design system; use get_component_styled when you want one specific component already paired with the style.

slug.description: Style slug exactly as listed by list_styles.

name: get_style
title: Get brand style
